::: {#def-conjugate-prior}
#### Conjugate prior

A family $\distfam$ of [prior distributions](#def-prior) is **conjugate**
to a [likelihood](intro-MLEs.qmd#def-lik)
if, for every [prior](#def-prior) $\p(\param)$ in the family
and every possible [data set](model-validation.qmd#def-data-set) $\vy$,
the [posterior](#def-posterior) is also in the family:

$$\p(\param) \in \distfam \implies \p(\param \mid \vy) \in \distfam.$$

Source: @wikipedia_conjugate_prior.
:::
